statement.p: Last year, Joan received a {1.5\%} raise. This year, she received a {3\%} raise. Her current wage is {\$11} an hour. What was her wage before the two raises?

solution.p: We can represent this situation with the equation: x \cdot (1 + 0.015) \cdot (1 + 0.03) = 11\text{.} Solve this equation for x\text{.}
